specimens.name: Perforated steel cable-tray segment
specimens.notes: Perforated steel cable tray is isolated; neatly routed multi-core bundle is retained by uniform clips.

specimens.name: Bundled electrical harness on standardized clamps
specimens.notes: Parallel insulated cable harness is held by repeated standardized clamps on a short mounting strip.

specimens.name: Steel electrical conduit 90-degree sweep
specimens.notes: Factory-formed steel 90-degree conduit sweep is isolated with one threaded union and no junction box.

specimens.name: Die-cast junction box
specimens.notes: Gasketed die-cast junction box has removable lid and two standardized glands with no attached cables.

specimens.name: Painted steel pipe 90-degree elbow
specimens.notes: Painted steel 90-degree pipe elbow is isolated with one union and no valve or surrounding network.

specimens.name: Flanged pipe joint
specimens.notes: Two short pipe ends use matching circular flanges, visible gasket edge and evenly spaced bolts.

specimens.name: Hydraulic hose segment
specimens.notes: Reinforced black hydraulic hose has crimped ferrule fittings and one bend restrictor; no manifold.

specimens.name: Compact solenoid valve manifold block
specimens.notes: Compact manifold block has four visible fluid ports and two coil housings with no hoses or wires.
